name: Billion Dollar Mental Models Toolkit
description: Tools and skills derived from 89 documents that moved billions in capital

tools.name: Expectations Investing Reverse DCF
tools.description: Reverse-engineer market expectations from stock price to find gaps
steps: Input current stock price and financials
Run reverse DCF to find implied growth/margin expectations
Compare to base rates and historical analogs
Assess if expectations are realistic or over/under-priced
Size position based on conviction and margin of safety

tools.name: Magic Formula Screen
tools.description: Mechanical screen for good businesses at bargain prices
steps: Rank universe by Earnings Yield (EBIT/EV)
Rank universe by Return on Capital (EBIT/(NFA+WC))
Combine ranks; buy top 20-30
Hold 1 year; rebalance annually
Ignore macro; trust the process

tools.name: Howard Marks Cycle Positioning
tools.description: Assess where we are in market cycle and position accordingly
steps: Identify current cycle phase: excess/correction/recovery
Assess risk: permanent loss vs volatility
Second-level thinking: what does consensus miss?
Counter-cyclical: buy when others are fearful
Patient opportunism: wait for fat pitches

tools.name: Grantham Mean Reversion / Blood in Streets
tools.description: Deploy capital at maximum pessimism into quality assets
steps: Identify assets at multi-year lows with quality fundamentals
Verify 'blood in streets' sentiment (max fear)
Check career risk: institutions can't buy; you can
Size position for conviction
Hold through recovery; mean reversion is iron law

tools.name: Zero to One Monopoly Finder
tools.description: Find secrets and build monopolies, not competitive businesses
steps: Identify secrets: important truths few agree with
Start small: dominate a niche 10x better
Check monopoly traits: proprietary tech, network effects, scale, brand
Expand concentrically: niche → adjacent → broad
Avoid competition: it's for losers

tools.name: Do Things That Don't Scale Engine
tools.description: Manual user acquisition and product discovery before automation
steps: Identify early adopters with acute pain
Manually onboard/serve each one (consulting mode)
Learn exactly what they need; build that
Document every interaction; find patterns
Automate only after product-market fit proven

tools.name: Blitzscaling vs Adapting to Endure Selector
tools.description: Choose the right scaling strategy for your market and era
steps: Assess market: winner-take-all + network effects? → Blitzscale
Assess capital environment: ZIRP? → Blitzscale; Rising rates? → Endure
Blitzscale: raise > need, hire for trajectory, accept chaos
Endure: extend runway 36mo, profitability = optionality, cut burn
Reassess quarterly; switch modes if regime changes

tools.name: Founder Mode Operating System
tools.source: Brian Chesky (59), Elon Musk (64), Jensen Huang (60)
tools.description: Stay in details; avoid manager mode abstraction layers
steps: Review product details weekly (pixels, specs, UX)
Interview IC candidates personally for key roles
Write specs/memos; don't delegate thinking
Lead crises personally (COVID, production hell)
Resist board pressure to 'professionalize' prematurely

tools.name: Audience-First Product Builder
tools.source: Nathan Barry (76), Pieter Levels (77), Daniel Vassallo (79)
tools.description: Build audience → launch products → compound income streams
steps: Teach everything you know publicly (write, video, tweet)
Build email list / following around expertise
Launch micro-products to audience (courses, tools, SaaS)
Charge from day 1; no free tiers
Diversify: portfolio of small bets > all-in on one

tools.name: Scaling Laws Compute Allocator
tools.description: Optimize compute/data/model allocation for AI training
steps: Determine compute budget (FLOPs)
Apply Chinchilla: N ~ C^0.5, D ~ C^0.5 (20 tokens/param)
Invest in data quality/curation > model size
Bet on scaling: no saturation observed
The Bitter Lesson: general methods + compute > human knowledge

tools.name: Software 2.0 Architecture Designer
steps: Replace explicit logic (if/else) with learned functions
Make entire pipeline differentiable end-to-end
Curate datasets; design loss functions (not code)
Target GPU/TPU/NPU compilation
Debug via data inspection, loss analysis, adversarial examples

tools.name: AI Moat Evaluator (New Moats)
tools.description: Assess defensibility of AI companies beyond model access
steps: Check data network effects: usage → training data → better model
Verify closed-loop: model improves automatically with use
Assess workflow integration: AI embedded in core business process
Evaluate proprietary data moat vs public data
Cost disruption check: can RL/ distillation replicate at 1/100th cost?

tools.name: Dalio Big Cycle Navigator
tools.description: Navigate 250-year empire cycles and 50-75 year debt cycles
steps: Identify cycle stage: new order → prosperity → excess → conflict → revolution
US position: late stage (high debt, polarization, rising China)
Diversify: 15+ uncorrelated return streams (Holy Grail)
Hedge currency debasement: gold, bitcoin, real assets
Study history: patterns rhyme; don't fight the cycle

tools.name: Fiscal Dominance / 1940s Playbook
tools.description: Position for fiscal dominance: debt/GDP > 120% → yield curve control → inflation
steps: Monitor debt/GDP and fiscal deficit trajectory
Identify yield curve control / financial repression signals
Allocate to hard assets: energy, commodities, bitcoin
Avoid long-duration nominal bonds (negative real yields)
Expect structural inflation, not transitory

tools.name: Reflexivity Trade Finder
tools.description: Trade narrative inflection points where beliefs shape fundamentals
steps: Identify trend + misconception reinforcing each other
Watch for 'this time is different' narrative
Trade the reflexive loop inflection (not static value)
Concentrated bets: 1-3 positions = 80% portfolio
Cut losses instantly; let winners run

tools.name: Munger Latticework Decision Checklist
tools.description: Multi-disciplinary mental model checklist to avoid stupidity
steps: Invert: how could this go wrong? (avoid stupidity > seek brilliance)
Check incentives: 'show me the incentive, I'll show you the outcome'
Run base rates: reference class forecasting, not single case
Apply 25 cognitive biases checklist (social proof, availability, etc.)
Lollapalooza check: multiple biases combining?

tools.name: Antifragile Life Designer
tools.description: Build life that gains from disorder, not just survives it
steps: Barbell strategy: 90% safe (cash, skills, health) + 10% speculative
Via negativa: remove fragilities (debt, single points of failure)
Skin in the game: only take advice from those with downside
Lindy effect: prefer time-tested (books, habits, relationships)
Optionality: maximize future choices, minimize obligations

tools.name: Psychology of Money Wealth Builder
tools.description: Build sustainable wealth via behavior, not brilliance
steps: Wealth = what you don't see (savings rate > returns)
Room for error: survive to let compounding work
Reasonable > rational: sustainable behavior beats optimal theory
Tails drive outcomes: few decisions = most impact
Freedom = highest form of wealth (control over time)

tools.name: Energy Reality Check
steps: Energy transitions take decades (not years)
Power density: fossils dense, renewables diffuse
4 pillars of civilization: cement, steel, ammonia, plastics
No silver bullet; innovation is incremental
Numbers don't lie: growth has thermodynamic limits
